source.note: Minimal paper-derived-method fixture for coding-agent smoke tests.

algorithm_steps.description: Construct complete-case matrix for the selected outcome and predictors.
Run bootstrap resampling of the complete-case data.
Fit the specified interpretable model inside each bootstrap sample.
Report coefficient sign stability across bootstrap samples.
Report held-out or cross-validated fit for the final model.

assumptions.name: sufficient_complete_cases
assumptions.description: The complete-case sample size must be large enough for resampling.

assumptions.name: non_constant_variables
assumptions.description: Outcome and predictors must have non-zero variance.
